target_customer: Physical therapists who want to run independent practices; patients (Medicare, in home)
problem: Therapists lose time to credentialing, billing and documentation, which keeps many employed by large clinics.
business_model: Services and software platform for independent PTs; revenue model not stated
product_category: Healthcare practice enablement, AI EHR and billing for physical therapy

founders.name: Stephen Grinich
founders.background_notes: YC page gives no background. A directory names Jonah Tuchow as CTO; no company source confirms, so not listed as co-founder.

technical_complexity.rationale: CRUD style EHR and billing workflows with AI scribe; payer contracting and credentialing are operational rather than technical hurdles.

defensibility.rationale: Payer contracts and credentialing across states take effort, but PT EMR vendors can add similar features.

market_need_then: Independent PTs face administrative overhead and Medicare billing complexity; no dated spending evidence was found.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name shared with a foundation and a Harvard newsletter; no brand assets found.

pivots.from: Business in a box for PTs going independent (YC description, Fall 2024)
pivots.to: Home based outpatient PT for Medicare patients in greater Los Angeles (current website)
pivots.why: Not stated; website now describes a care delivery model. Date not given.

outcome_analysis: HealthSpark joined YC in Fall 2024 with one listed founder and has since presented itself as an in home PT provider in greater Los Angeles, suggesting a shift from software toward delivering care. No verified funding, exit or traction numbers were found, so the outcome is unknown and the record is early stage.
notes: VCBacked lists $500K pre-seed Dec 2024 from YC; no press release or Form D; unverified and not recorded as a round. Competitors listed in search results were undated 2025 and 2026 comparison pages, so none are recorded as of founding. A directory claims Grinich worked at Rad AI and 98point6 from a vendor blog; not used. Pivot is inferred from the website versus YC description and is flagged uncertain. Conflict on Jonah Tuchow: the healthcarediscovery.ai directory lists him as CTO alongside Grinich and a search summary says Crunchbase lists him as CTO and co-founder, but Crunchbase returned HTTP 403 when opened, and the YC company page, the YC launch post and the company site name no one but Grinich. He is not recorded as a co-founder. Completeness pass: the $500K pre-seed of Dec 2024 rests on VCBacked (single database); a GetLatka figure is only an estimate and no filing confirms it.
